decision.name: 新宝股份
reasoning: The hub-first signal identified channel flexibility as the economic change rather than simply strong appliance demand.
By the cutoff, H1 domestic sales had grown 90.87%, Morphy Richards domestic revenue about 240%, total revenue 24.78%, attributable profit 79.19% and operating cash flow 34.76%.
The company had both global OEM/ODM exposure and a functioning domestic-brand engine, giving a direct company-level expression of the channel-pivot hypothesis.
60d price excess was already about +15.1pp, while 20d excess was only about +0.8pp; prior absorption is material but not an accelerating chase signal.
Pandemic-related home-appliance demand durability and expectation burden are not resolved enough for High-priority.
